name: BASEBALL
description: Baseball is a thematic 7-Card Stud poker variant where 3s and 9s are wild, and 4s earn players extra cards. It is primarily played as a high-action 'Dealer's Choice' game in North American home poker circles. For the full technical specification, mechanical rules, and engine data, please see the master entry for Baseball Poker.

content.text: Baseball is a thematic 7-Card Stud poker variant where 3s and 9s are wild, and 4s earn players extra cards. It is primarily played as a high-action 'Dealer's Choice' game in North American home poker circles. For the full technical specification, mechanical rules, and engine data, please see the master entry for Baseball Poker.

Originating in mid-20th century America, Baseball capitalized on the popularity of 7-Card Stud and the national obsession with the sport. It became a staple of 'social' poker where the goal was to create massive, wild hands that would be impossible in formal casino play.
Two to six players. Because face-up fours grant extra cards, more than six players risks running out of deck; the game is therefore capped at six.

items.text: Face-up 3 match pot: A player who is dealt a three face up must immediately either match the pot or fold, or pay a fixed amount to the pot.
Face-down 4s extra card: Some play that concealed fours also grant an extra card when revealed; timing of reveal varies by house rules.
Football: Threes and sixes are wild; a two grants the player an extra card.
Woolworth: Fives and tens are wild; some play that a two grants an extra card.
